report.construction: frozen M3 ranked list + citation-graph items recorded in the independent M4 run, deduplicated against M3 and appended in traversal order

run_variance.description: Two independent executions of the M3 configuration (the M3 run and the keyword phase of the M4 run), collected minutes apart in the same session

language_analysis.note: Only German and French carry non-English gold annotations; claims about other target languages are unsupported by this reference set. Language labels come from provider metadata.

method_overlap.note: Counts are unique (variant, paper) pairs. 'only_in_row_not_in_col' counts gold papers the row method finds that the column method misses; methods were separate live runs.

fusion.note: Offline fusion of the two recorded runs; no new retrieval. Union is order-free; RRF produces a fused ranking evaluated like any other method.

provenance.note: Wall-clock, sequential per-variant execution, single run; includes provider rate-limit backoff and network variance. Paper counts match collected_results.json exactly (426/600/578/780).

external_baselines.note: Direct single-source REST queries with the gold English query; default API relevance ranking; no LLM, no federation. Collected on a later date than the main runs (disclosed in the paper).

run_manifest.candidate_budget_per_method: 20 keyword candidates per variant; citation traversal budget 20 papers, depth 1, direction both

run_manifest.runs: single collection run per method (no repeated trials); run-to-run variance estimated from the duplicated M3 configuration
